title: skilldrop catalogue.json
$comment: RFC-0026 / RFC-0034 / RFC-0046. The catalogue index: pack display order, the outcome axis, and the skills that have left the catalogue. Packs answer WHO needs a skill (the folder it sits in); outcomes answer WHY someone opened the catalogue.

packs.description: Every pack folder under packs/, in display order. validate.py checks both directions.

outcomes.description: The catalogue's second browse axis. A browse aid only — never an install unit; the CLI takes no --outcome.

for.description: Who this job belongs to, shown on the home page's outcome cards.

description.description: The chip's tooltip on the catalogue site.

retired.description: RFC-0046. Skills removed from the catalogue, so an installed copy can say why it stopped updating. A retired name has no folder and nothing references it; validate.py checks both.

in.description: The skilldrop-cli version that removed it.

why.description: One sentence, shown by outdated, update, doctor, diff, info and install.

instead.description: A skill that covers the same job, when one does. Omit it when the agent without a skill does as well.
